title: Self-Existence of God
definition: The self-existence of God means that God has life in Himself and depends on nothing outside Himself for existence, power, wisdom, or fullness.
summary: God exists from Himself and is dependent on no one and nothing.
christFocus: Jesus shares divine life with the Father and gives life to those who come to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's self-existence means He is not caused, sustained, or completed by anything outside Himself. Every creature receives life, but God has life in Himself. He is not needy, dependent, or lacking.

This truth separates the Creator from creation. God does not exist because the world exists; the world exists because God spoke and sustains it. His being is eternal, independent, and full.

The self-existent God graciously gives life to others. In Christ, eternal life is revealed and given to those who believe.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often imagine God as though He needs human approval, service, or worship in order to be complete. This doctrine matters because it teaches that God is perfectly full in Himself and that all life is received from Him as grace.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive your life as a gift, not an entitlement. Worship God as the One who depends on nothing, and trust Him as the source of all true life.
